question: Which famous Indian dancer became the first woman to be nominated as a member of Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rukmini Devi Arundale**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale** became the** first woman to be nominated as a member of the Rajya Sabha**.
 
• She was a renowned Indian classical dancer and choreographer of the Bharatanatyam dance form.
 
• Rukmini Devi was instrumental in **reviving Bharatanatyam** from a dying art to one of the most popular and respected classical dance forms in India today.
 
• Her nomination to the Rajya Sabha was a recognition of her contributions to Indian art and culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Rajya Sabha, or Council of States, is the upper house of the Parliament of India.
 
• Members of the Rajya Sabha are nominated for their expertise in fields such as literature, science, art, and social service.
 
• Rukmini Devi Arundale was also known for her efforts in **animal welfare and was a strong advocate for vegetarianism**.
 
• She founded the **Kalakshetra Foundation in Chennai**, which continues to be a premier institution for the education and preservation of Indian classical arts.
